description.text: The second round of Pokémon TCG Gym promos, from the Present Pack given out in Malaysia, Singapore and the Philippines. Gym shops give these promos out as participation prizes, while stocks last. Each is an English card reprinted with the Pokémon TCG Gym stamp, keeping its original's number. This round reprints cards of the later Scarlet & Violet sets, such as Latias ex, Iron Thorns ex, Bloodmoon Ursaluna ex, Dusknoir, Eevee, Regigigas and Trainers like Buddy-Buddy Poffin, Crispin and Iris's Fighting Spirit.
